messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Increase in 5xx on /v1/generate detected. Paging @devops-oncall @Emily Chen @Samir Patel. Error rate > 30% for the last 3 minutes.

devops-oncall: On it. pulling logs now, will report back in 2min.

Emily Chen: seeing a surge of 503s from runtime-g1, approx 02:14-02:26 UTC. Tail of the pod logs shows repeated OOM-ish failure in the LM runtime process.

Samir Patel: I’m seeing a pattern of KV cache eviction spikes correlated with long sequences. Could be memory fragmentation.

devops-oncall: Rolling back the canary we deployed at 01:58 UTC to eliminate code change as cause. Command:

```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-runtime --namespace=prod --to-revision=24
```

devops-oncall: rollback started. also bumping replicas on runtime-g1 from 6 -> 10 to soak load.

Olga (PM): Is this affecting hosted-api customers? any billing/major customers impacted?

Emily Chen: Hosted API in eu-west and us-east showing elevated error rates. Quick estimate: ~1.9k failed requests, 12 minutes window. No PII leaked.

Samir Patel: I toggled a temporary routing policy to fallback-model-v2 for low latency routes. That reduced error rate by ~70% but some clients hit compatibility quirks.

devops-oncall: rollback finished @ 02:20 UTC. replica scale complete @ 02:22 UTC. Error rate dropped back to baseline by 02:26 UTC.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: green (mitigated). Duration ~28m from first alert to baseline. Page ended.

Olga (PM): Thanks. We need a post-incident review and owners for action items. Proposing postmortem draft + peer review tomorrow 11:00 PST. Who can own the RCA writeup? @Alex Rivers?

Alex Rivers: I’ll take the RCA draft. I can put up a first pass by EOD today. Will include timeline, contributing factors, and customer impact summary.

Maria Gomez: I’ll be primary on the remediation tracks — will triage autoscaler and memory configs.

Samir Patel: I’ll dig into the KV cache eviction traces and quantize memory allocation patterns. Noted.

Emily Chen: I’ll add the runtime logs and the exact pod failure traces to the RCA doc. Also add the mitigation commands we ran.

devops-oncall: For the postmortem meeting, can we include oncall runbook updates? The autoscaler did not trigger earlier than expected.

Olga (PM): Yes. Agenda for the postmortem meeting:
- 5m quick incident recap
- 10m timeline walkthrough (Alex)
- 15m technical root cause (Samir/Emily)
- 10m customer impact & comms (Olga)
- 15m action item assignment & deadlines

Olga (PM): Action items from this thread (initial):
1) Autoscaler tuning review (owner: Maria Gomez) — due: 2026-03-18
2) KV cache memory fragmentation analysis (owner: Samir Patel) — due: 2026-03-19
3) Runbook update: emergency rollback + scale playbook (owner: devops-oncall) — due: 2026-03-17
4) RCA draft (owner: Alex Rivers) — first pass due EOD today, peer-review by 2026-03-17
5) Customer impact note & comms draft (owner: Olga (PM)) — due: 2026-03-17

Alex Rivers: Draft link (first pass): https://docs.internal.redwood/rcas/1798123456-rca-draft (please add comments inline).

Maria Gomez: I'll add the autoscaler logs to the doc and flag suspicious scaling windows.

Samir Patel: Will upload KV heap dumps and a short script to reproduce memory pressure in a test cluster.

Emily Chen: tagging @devops-oncall for the rollback steps snippet for the runbook.

devops-oncall: noted, will write the runbook snippet and include the exact commands + verification steps.

Olga (PM): Peer reviewers: @Samir Patel, @Emily Chen, @Maria Gomez. After peer reviews are in, schedule sign-off with Eng Leads.

incident-bot: Reminder set: postmortem-meeting tomorrow 19 Mar 2026 11:00 PST.

Alex Rivers: Quick timeline for RCA draft (to include in doc):
- 01:58 UTC: canary deploy (sha: b4f3a)
- 02:12 UTC: incident-bot alert: error rate spike on /v1/generate
- 02:14-02:20 UTC: OOM-like traces in runtime-g1 pods, scaling not triggered fast enough
- 02:18 UTC: Samir toggles fallback routing to v2 model
- 02:20 UTC: rollback initiated
- 02:22 UTC: manual scale up to 10 replicas
- 02:26 UTC: error rate returns to baseline

Olga (PM): Can all owners add estimated effort (hrs) next to their actions in the doc so we can prioritize?

Emily Chen: Will add logs + a 2hr estimate for log triage + 6hr for a deeper instrumentation pass.

Samir Patel: KV analysis: estimate 8hrs.

Maria Gomez: Autoscaler tuning: estimate 6hrs plus 2hr verification and one follow-up meeting.

devops-oncall: Runbook update: ~3hrs.

Olga (PM): Good. Once peer review is done, we'll move to sign-off. Asking Eng Leads @CTO and @VP-Infra to confirm by 2026-03-20.

Alex Rivers: Draft is up — ping me with comments. Will incorporate and then request formal sign-off thread.

Emily Chen: handoff to next oncall @Emily Chen for the maintenance window tonight — will watch for regressions and validate runbook steps.

devops-oncall: Thanks team. Closing thread here but keeping the follow-up items in the issue tracker and the RCA doc. :white_check_mark:
